_comment: Gmail organizer rules (scripts/gmail_organizer.py). Owner's tree, 14 Nov 2026: ONLY Amazon (10 labels), Zoro (8, Tax Zoro added 14 Nov) and MaxWarehouse (2); all of them skip the inbox, everything else comes into the inbox unlabelled. Each rule is also a Gmail filter (--sync-filters); the hourly run labels what no filter did (first matching rule wins). Gmail applies EVERY matching filter, so queries must not overlap (--dry-run prints overlaps). read=true: marked read (routine records); without it the mail stays unread so the label's count is a to-do list. Nothing is ever deleted; no automation reads the inbox, labels or unread state.
_hub_comment: 14 Nov 2026: owner wants no per-source Mailbox/… folders in the hub — mailbox_label empty = off.

rules.label: Amazon/Sold, Ship Now
rules.query: subject:"Sold, ship now"

rules.label: Amazon/Returns
rules.query: subject:("Return authorization notification" OR "Return authorization request")

rules.label: Amazon/Refunds
rules.query: subject:"Refund Initiated"

rules.label: Amazon/Customer Messages Sent
rules.query: subject:"Your e-mail to"

rules.label: Amazon/Customer Messages Received
rules.query: from:marketplace.amazon.com -subject:"Your e-mail to"

rules.label: Amazon/Listings Created & Updates
rules.query: ((from:amazon.com -from:(marketplace.amazon.com OR atoz-guarantee-no-reply@amazon.com OR cb-seller-notification@amazon.com) subject:(listing OR listings OR "New Product Success" OR "Featured Offer" OR "peak season" OR "price recommendation" OR "List Price" OR "Shipping options suppressed") -subject:("Sold, ship now" OR "Your e-mail to" OR "Order cancelation request" OR CaseID OR CASE OR "Return authorization" OR "Refund Initiated")) OR from:(price-recommendations-us@amazon.com OR buyability-improvement-na@amazon.com)) -from:(sell.amazon.com OR ads.amazon.com)

rules.label: Amazon/Cancelled Orders
rules.query: from:amazon.com subject:"Order cancelation request"

rules.label: Amazon/Cancelled Orders
rules.query: from:amazon.com -from:(marketplace.amazon.com OR atoz-guarantee-no-reply@amazon.com OR cb-seller-notification@amazon.com) subject:("has been cancelled" OR "has been canceled") -subject:("Order cancelation request" OR "Sold, ship now" OR "Your e-mail to")

rules.label: Amazon/Cases
rules.query: from:amazon.com -from:marketplace.amazon.com subject:"Thank you for submitting a new contact"

rules.label: Amazon/Cases
rules.query: (from:(merch.service05@amazon.com OR seller-performance@amazon.com) OR (from:(do-not-reply@amazon.com OR donotreply@amazon.com) subject:(CaseID OR CASE) -subject:("Sold, ship now" OR "Your e-mail to" OR "Listing Created" OR "Order cancelation request"))) -subject:"Thank you for submitting a new contact"

rules.label: Amazon/Account Health
rules.query: from:order-update@amazon.com subject:("at risk of" OR "Action Required")

rules.label: Amazon/Account Health
rules.query: (from:amazon.com -from:(order-update@amazon.com OR cb-seller-notification@amazon.com OR atoz-guarantee-no-reply@amazon.com OR marketplace.amazon.com OR merch.service05@amazon.com OR seller-performance@amazon.com) subject:("Performance Notification" OR "policy violation" OR deactivated OR deactivation OR suspended OR "Rights Infringement" OR "Infringement Complaint" OR "account health" OR "selling account" OR "Revision to Your Amazon.com Account") -subject:(listing OR listings OR "New Product Success" OR "Featured Offer" OR "peak season" OR "price recommendation" OR "List Price" OR "Shipping options suppressed") -subject:(CaseID OR CASE OR "Sold, ship now" OR "Your e-mail to")) -from:(sell.amazon.com OR ads.amazon.com)

rules.label: Amazon/Claims (A-to-z & Chargebacks)
rules.query: (from:(atoz-guarantee-no-reply@amazon.com OR cb-seller-notification@amazon.com) OR (from:amazon.com -from:marketplace.amazon.com subject:(chargeback OR chargebacks OR "A-to-z") -subject:("Sold, ship now" OR "Your e-mail to"))) -from:(sell.amazon.com OR ads.amazon.com)

rules.label: Zoro/Orders Received
rules.query: from:zoro@e.zoro.com subject:"has been received"

rules.label: Zoro/Orders Shipped
rules.query: from:zoro@e.zoro.com subject:"has shipped"

rules.label: Zoro/Invoices & Cash Sales Receipts
rules.query: from:do-not-reply@zoro.com subject:(Receipt OR "Sales Order" OR Invoice) -subject:("Cash Refund" OR "Credit Memo" OR Case)

rules.label: Zoro/Delivered
rules.query: from:zoro@e.zoro.com subject:Delivered

rules.label: Zoro/Order Cancellations
rules.query: (from:zoro@e.zoro.com subject:("important change" OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation) -subject:("has been received" OR "has shipped" OR Delivered)) OR (from:(askzoro@zoro.com OR resolution_team@zoro.com) subject:(cancel OR cancels OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation)) OR (from:do-not-reply@zoro.com subject:Case subject:(cancel OR cancels OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation))

rules.label: Zoro/Refunds & Credit Memos
rules.query: from:do-not-reply@zoro.com (subject:("Cash Refund" OR "Credit Memo") OR (subject:Case subject:(refund OR refunds))) -subject:(cancel OR cancels OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation) -subject:(return OR returns OR "Return Authorization" OR "Return Auth" OR "Return Confirmation")

rules.label: Zoro/Refunds & Credit Memos
rules.query: from:(askzoro@zoro.com OR resolution_team@zoro.com) subject:(refund OR refunds) -subject:(cancel OR cancels OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation) -subject:(return OR returns OR "Return Authorization" OR "Return Auth" OR "Return Confirmation")

rules.label: Zoro/Returns
rules.query: from:(zoro.narvar.com OR zoro.narvarnotify.com OR rxo.com) OR (from:do-not-reply@zoro.com subject:(return OR returns OR "Return Authorization" OR "Return Auth" OR "Return Confirmation") -subject:(cancel OR cancels OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation) -subject:("Cash Refund" OR "Credit Memo"))

rules.label: Zoro/Returns
rules.query: from:(askzoro@zoro.com OR resolution_team@zoro.com) subject:(return OR returns OR "Return Authorization" OR "Return Auth" OR "Return Confirmation") -subject:(cancel OR cancels OR cancelled OR canceled OR cancellation OR cancelation)

rules.label: Zoro/Tax Zoro
rules.query: from:(salestaxzoro@zoro.com OR salestax@zoro.com)

rules.label: MaxWarehouse/Orders Received
rules.query: from:maxwarehouse.com subject:"order has been received"

rules.label: MaxWarehouse/Orders Shipped
rules.query: from:maxwarehouse.com subject:(shipment OR shipped) -subject:(canceled OR cancelled OR "order has been received")
